windows.label: Human
windows.text: Look at the most recent conflicts and ask if you were able to regulate yourself during them. What did you do to (through) or do you keep falling for the same stuff?

windows.label: Human
windows.text: What would your friends or exes say?

windows.label: Human
windows.text: And if you tell me you shut down, okay, what does that mean: did you stop talking to your partner for days, and did they feel abandoned?
